touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: A practical service town with rail access, local paths and links to the coast, but limited destination character in the modern centre.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Public outdoor routes can form part of a dog visit, with ordinary close-control restrictions around roads, livestock, wildlife and shared spaces.

townGuide.headline: A recorded locality rather than a tourist destination
townGuide.intro: The town’s loops, station and services make it useful to visitors, while Findon, Old Portlethen, Downies and the coastal scenery retain their own scores.
perfectFor: Identifying the locality while planning a wider route
townGuide.visitorMood: Kept in the selector for completeness, but deliberately absent from the tourist-town map below 60.
